## Statistics for Experimentalists

In 2026, I'm a teaching assistant for **ME414 — Statistics for Experimentalists** at IMECC, UNICAMP, through the university's **Teaching Internship Program (PED)**. My teaching periods are March–June and August–December.

I help students work through probability distributions, estimation, hypothesis testing, regression, and analysis of variance. Alongside regular office hours, I've delivered selected lectures and guided problem-solving sessions on statistical inference.
